name: page-control
title: Page Control
description: A row of dots, one for each page, the current one solid, that shows where a person is in a flat list of pages and moves between them, as the iOS 26 page control does.
docs: Import as `import { PageControl } from '@/components/ui/page-control'`. See https://plexui.com/vue/components/page-control for props and examples.
